t: Maboy shetztziddo echad nokri vetziddo echad yisrael
s: Maboy shetztziddo echad nokri vetziddo echad yisrael ubo b' seipim: maboy sheddarim bo nokri veyisrael echad — shemmuttar letaltel bammaboy, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shtz"a — veyesh bayit echad etzel beto shel zeh, veeno patuach lemaboy zeh ella lemaboy acher o lirshut harabbim, veyesh challon beno leyisrael — haddar bemaboy zeh eno yakol leareb immo al yede hachallon shebbenehem kede lehotzi kelayv lemaboy zeh derek beto shel zeh happatuach lemaboy zeh, lepi sheasur laasot siyyua leyachid haddar im nokri, kemo shennitbaer besimman shp"b. Vaapillu im yisreelim rabbim darim bechatzer achat — hare hem keyachid leinyan tiltul bammaboy, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shtz"a. Abal im yesh petach benehem — yakol leareb immo, kemo shennitbaer besimman shp"b:

Maboy sheddarim bo yisreelim venokri, beinyan shehannokri oser alehem bammaboy, veyesh challonot petuchot bishkunot hayyisreelim mibbayit lebayit o mechatzer lechatzer, veerebu yachad al yede hachallonot shebbenehem, ap al pi shennaasu keanshe bayit echad umuttarim lehotzi ulehaknis derek challonot mibbayit lebayit umechatzer lechatzer — hare ellu asurim lehishtammesh bammaboy derek pitchehem ad sheyyiskeru min hannokri, sheal yede erub enan naasim keyachid bimqom nokri, kemo shennitbaer besimman shp"b:
